name: Executer AC
summary: Executer AC is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses the Accelerator Oscillator (AC) indicator by Bill Williams to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the AC indicator shows positive momentum shifts and enters short positions on negative momentum shifts, typically operating on medium timeframes. The EA applies systematic signal-based entries with the AC oscillator as its sole decision driver.
summary_zh: Executer AC是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，使用比尔·威廉姆斯的加速振荡器(AC)指标生成交易信号。当AC指标显示正向动量转变时做多，负向动量转变时做空，通常在中周期时间框架上运行。该EA以AC振荡器作为唯一决策驱动因素进行系统性信号入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速振荡器(AC)指标，该指标衡量价格动量的加速或减速变化。入场条件为：当AC指标从负值区域转为正值并连续出现更高柱状时做多，从正值区域转为负值并连续出现更低柱状时做空。出场条件通常依赖于反向AC信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数大小，但没有看到基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，缺乏复杂的资金管理策略，如根据波动率调整仓位或基于权益的仓位缩放。整体策略逻辑简单直接，依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多重确认和过滤机制，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Accelerator Oscillator (AC) indicator, which measures the acceleration or deceleration of price momentum. Entry conditions are: go long when the AC indicator shifts from negative to positive territory and shows consecutive higher histogram bars, and go short when it shifts from positive to negative with consecutive lower bars. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing AC signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. In terms of position sizing, the EA allows users to customize lot size but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is rudimentary with no sophisticated strategies such as volatility-based position scaling or equity-linked sizing adjustments. The overall strategy logic is simple and direct, relying on a single indicator signal without multi-confirmation or filtering mechanisms, making it prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets.

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调试
使用比尔·威廉姆斯经典指标，理论基础扎实
参数较少，适合新手用户使用和调整
信号生成机制清晰，减少了过度拟合的风险
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Uses Bill Williams' classic indicator with solid theoretical foundation
Few parameters make it suitable for beginners to use and adjust
Clear signal generation mechanism reduces risk of overfitting
cons: 仅依赖单一AC指标，缺乏多维度确认，在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号
默认止损止盈为零，存在较大的资金风险敞口
没有动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动率调整交易规模
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
cons_en: Relies solely on the AC indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false signals in ranging markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating significant capital risk exposure
No dynamic position sizing, unable to adjust trade size based on market volatility
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
No spread filter, which may be detrimental in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加多指标确认机制，如结合AO或Alligator指标过滤信号，减少虚假入场
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，提高风险管理的适应性
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation mechanism, such as combining AO or Alligator indicator to filter signals and reduce false entries
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing to improve risk management adaptability

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，交易可能无限亏损
缺乏持仓检查和新K线检查，可能导致重复开仓和过度暴露
单一指标策略在不利市场条件下可能持续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, trades can have unlimited losses
Lacks position check and new bar check, potentially causing repeated position openings and overexposure
Single indicator strategy may sustain continuous losses in unfavorable market conditions
